# Q3 2024 Regional Revenue Rankings

**Prepared by:** Finance Operations  
**Report date:** 2026-11-01  
**Source dataset:** `q3_2024_regional_sales_final`

---

## 1. Dataset Verification

Before analysis, the source spreadsheet was independently verified against two criteria:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Spreadsheet description | *"Canonical closed-books dataset for Q3 2024 regional revenue after reconciliation sign-off."* ✅ |
| `book_status` for every row | `closed` on all 4 rows ✅ |

> **Conclusion:** `q3_2024_regional_sales_final` is confirmed as the canonical, post-reconciliation, closed-books dataset. It is safe to use for internal reporting and downstream finance processes.

---

## 2. Regional Revenue Rankings — Q3 2024

| Rank | Region | Revenue | vs. Total |
|:---:|---|---:|---:|
| 🥇 1 | West  | $910,000 | 26.9% |
| 🥈 2 | North | $870,000 | 25.7% |
| 🥉 3 | South | $815,000 | 24.1% |
|  4  | East  | $790,000 | 23.3% |

---

## 3. Summary Statistics

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| **Total Q3 Revenue** | **$3,385,000** |
| Average revenue per region | $846,250 |
| Highest region (West) | $910,000 |
| Lowest region (East) | $790,000 |
| Spread (High − Low) | $120,000 |
| Spread as % of total | 3.5% |

---

## 4. Key Observations

- **West leads** all regions with $910K, finishing $40K (≈4.4%) ahead of second-place North.
- **North and West are closely grouped** — together they account for 52.6% of total Q3 revenue.
- **South and East are similarly close**, separated by only $25K (3.1% relative gap), and together contribute 47.4% of total revenue.
- The overall spread between the top and bottom region is **$120K**, representing a relatively tight 3.5-percentage-point range across the four regions, suggesting balanced geographic performance in Q3 2024.
- No region falls below 23% of total revenue share, indicating no material underperformer at the regional level.
